findings.title: Overwrite safety covers two of the four output locations
findings.description:
The marker check inspects only `.github/copilot-instructions.md` and `AGENTS.md` (also line 109). The script also writes `.github/instructions/*.instructions.md` and `.github/prompts/*.prompt.md`, with generic names such as `typescript.instructions.md` and `commit.prompt.md`.

- **Requirement left unmet:** the plan requires that re-running with existing unmanaged files "prompts before overwriting", and the architecture says init is "never destructive — if unsure, ask or skip". An existing Copilot user adopting CF is the slice's stated driver and the most likely to already have such files.
- **No prompt under init:** slice 202 calls `setupIdeAction` with `yes: true`, so under `cf init --ide copilot` only the backup protects user files. No backup is specified for these two directories.
- **Worktrees:** propagation copies both directories into every worktree with no check.
- **Also unspecified:** the mixed case (one file managed, one not), the "`.bak` already exists" case from slice 202's strategy, and whether stale generated files are removed when a source rule disappears.

Fix: apply the marker rule per generated file — overwrite only files carrying the marker, back up or prompt otherwise.

findings.title: Translation source and rule classification are undefined
findings.description:
The layout says outputs come "from `.claude/rules/typescript.md`" and "from `.claude/skills/commit.md`". A Copilot-only project never has `.claude/`, and the design forbids writing it (line 17). That leaves two readings, and the design picks neither:

- **Source is the guide's own rule files:** then the input frontmatter is the guide's format, not Claude `paths`.
- **Source is `.claude/`:** then the copilot target silently depends on the claude target having run. That is a hidden dependency and contradicts the driver user, who cancelled Claude.

Three further gaps:

- **Classification key:** the split depends on `alwaysApply`, but the generated Claude rule files in this repo carry only `description` and `paths`.
- **Unreachable default:** line 83 equates "paths absent" with alwaysApply and routes those rules to the compiled file. The `applyTo: "**"` default can then never be emitted, though line 32 and the plan both require it.
- **Skill layout:** skills in this repo are directories (`.claude/skills/<name>/SKILL.md`), not the flat files the layout shows.

Fix: name the actual source directory, the frontmatter keys read, and the rule that decides compiled versus split.

findings.title: Skill-to-prompt and instruction-file frontmatter mapping not specified
findings.description: "Translate skills → `.github/prompts/`" is the whole specification. The plan's mapping table names the prompt frontmatter fields (`name`, `description`, `argument-hint`, `agent`, `model`, `tools`). The design does not say which skill fields map to which, what happens to fields with no equivalent (such as `disable-model-invocation`), or what happens to a skill's supporting files. For instruction files only `applyTo` is specified, though the referenced tool guide lists `name` and `description` as well and the source rules carry `description`. This leaves the plan's criterion for generating `.prompt.md` files from skills to implementer guesswork.

findings.title: Test coverage omits the translation, where the slice's risk sits
findings.description:
All seven listed tests exercise the CLI wrapper. None covers the guide script's output, although the plan rates the slice Med risk for "frontmatter translation correctness".

- **Unverified plan criteria:** "Path→applyTo translation correctly converts Claude frontmatter…" has no test. The four-artifact generation criterion is checked only as "files created".
- **Fixture format:** real rule files in this repo use multi-line `paths:` with trailing whitespace and varying indent. The design shows only one clean layout.
- **Missing manual check:** the plan's verification that a Copilot agent follows conventions from the generated files does not appear.

Fix: add script-level tests that run on real rule files and assert the emitted `applyTo`, the compiled/split routing and the prompt output.

findings.title: Failure handling for the script step and propagation is asserted, not specified
findings.description:
The design has no error-case list, unlike slice 177's.

- **Version skew:** the Risks section says an older guide without a `copilot` case "will fail … with a clear error". That is a property of the existing script the design does not establish. Guides are installed per project, so skew is the normal case for existing projects.
- **Ordering:** step 4 backs up and prompts before step 5 can fail.
- **Script failure:** behaviour on non-zero exit or partial output is not stated.
- **Empty categories:** the design does not say what propagation does when `.github/instructions/` or `.github/prompts/` does not exist because the project has no scoped rules or skills.
- **Worktree copy failure:** abort or continue, and whether it is reported, is not stated.
- **Observability:** under `cf init`, slice 202 downgrades IDE-step errors to warnings, so each of these needs a defined, visible outcome.

findings.title: Tool guide not referenced
findings.description: The plan's success criteria require `project-documents/user/tool-guides/copilot-vscode/setup-ide.md` to be "referenced in slice design, promoted to a proper published tool guide if needed". The design never mentions it and makes no promotion decision. The file is currently a raw chat export without frontmatter, and it is the only source for the `applyTo`, ordering and prompt-frontmatter facts the design relies on.

findings.title: Managed-marker helper is named two ways and duplicates the Claude check
findings.description: Line 29 specifies `isManagedCopilot(filePath)`; line 109 specifies `isManagedCopilotFiles(projectPath)`. The name and signature differ. The check is the same marker line in the first 20 lines as the existing Claude helper, so one file-level helper used by both targets is less code than a parallel copy. It also suits the "pattern for future targets" the Value section claims.

findings.title: Always-on content will be loaded more than once
findings.description: Writing identical content to `.github/copilot-instructions.md` and `AGENTS.md` follows the plan. Per the tool guide, both are always-on in VS Code, so Copilot receives the compiled rules twice. In the dual-write projects the design supports, the guide says VS Code also reads `CLAUDE.md` and `.claude/rules`, giving further copies. Worth stating as accepted, or giving `AGENTS.md` a thinner body.

findings.title: `cf init --ide copilot` still installs Claude slash commands
findings.description: With no `init.ts` changes, slice 202's command-install step still writes to `~/.claude/commands/cf/` for a Copilot-only user. The overview's "never to `.claude/`" claim holds for the project directory only. The plan's init criterion omits the command-install step, so the design should say whether this is intended.

findings.title: Custom-agent mapping is promised but not documented
findings.description: The plan row says "document mapping" and the design says "document the mapping but defer implementation", yet no mapping appears. "Unless the instruction + prompt layer lands cleanly" also leaves scope conditional. State it as deferred and either add the two-line mapping or point to the tool guide.
